description: The steps of an exchange in a live connection, played against one app: manifests, offers, answers, record messages, acknowledgements and errors (spec/protocol.md).

vectors.description: the highest common format
no common format
format 1 between two apps of 0.1.0
the key from which the sender last got a record message
a MANIFEST, a DEVICE_ADD and a DEVICE_REMOVE do not move the contact key
with no other message from any current key, any current key of which it holds a manifest
after the removal of the contact key, the current key it last got a message from
a key of which the sender holds no manifest is not the contact key
a record whose only outcome is of a removed key is sent again, one with an outcome of a current key is not
outcomes of two removed keys count for nothing
Old Brain Fix receives the exchange of protocol.md, section 17, its repeats and the messages it rejects

vectors.description: an offer of a type that does not fit the receiver's manifest is declined, whatever its user wants
the first messages: an OFFER before the MANIFEST, an invalid MANIFEST, a MANIFEST with a record
a DELETE without any accepted offer
APPLIED stands after KEPT then APPLIED
APPLIED stands after APPLIED then KEPT
MERGED stands after DUPLICATE then MERGED
MERGED stands after MERGED then DUPLICATE
WITHDRAWN stands after KEPT then WITHDRAWN
WITHDRAWN stands after WITHDRAWN then KEPT
a chain before the MANIFEST and a removal after it are applied or ignored without a reply
a DEVICE_JOIN in a connection that no join code opened is ignored without a report
a rejected DEVICE_ADD before the MANIFEST is reported once the MANIFEST has come
a DEVICE_REMOVE signed with a removed key, and one of its signer's own key, are reported to the connection key
the connection key is removed by its set: the connection is closed, and in a new connection its MANIFEST is rejected without a report
a DEVICE_ADD whose signature does not verify is reported, and Old Brain Fix may close the connection
the offers made to a key end when its sender removes the key, and the connection is closed

fields.name: notes

help_translations.de: Alles Weitere zum Termin.

fields.name: reminders
fields.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. Empty when there are no reminders.

texts.label: Reminders
texts.help: When to be reminded, each before or after the start.

help_translations.de: Wann erinnert werden soll, jeweils vor oder nach dem Beginn.

items.name: reminders
items.doc: When the user wants to be reminded, each as a duration added to start as spec/time.md, section 7.2, says: negative before start, such as -PT15M for 15 minutes before or -P1D for the day before at the same time on the wall clock, 0 at start, and positive after it. fields.name: relations
